auth.notes: Free tier requires no auth. POST /api/inbox returns {id, email}. The id is used for subsequent calls.

captcha.note: No CAPTCHA observed. Clean REST API.

create_inbox.notes: Returns inbox id and assigned email address. No auth required. Called on page load.

get_emails.notes: Returns list of emails for the inbox. Polled every 10s.

get_email.notes: Returns full email details including HTML body.

notes: Very clean REST API. Free plan: 1 inbox, 1-hour expiry. Domains: inboxly.website seen in browser capture. The id from POST /api/inbox must be stored to access messages. Implementation: create cli_openinbox.py.
